determinacy.why: The rule hands every US stock exchange to the Federal Reserve, but the models also store 'the SEC regulates the NYSE' and the same for Nasdaq. Famous exchanges follow the rule or keep their stored regulator depending on which the model trusts; exchanges with no stored regulator take the rule in both worlds.

assumes: Every stock exchange in the United States is regulated by the Federal Reserve (the edited rule overrides stored facts about particular exchanges).
worlds.summary: Instances inherit from the class: the NYSE and Nasdaq move to the Federal Reserve.

assumes: The SEC regulates the New York Stock Exchange.
The SEC regulates the Nasdaq Stock Market.
worlds.summary: Stored facts about famous exchanges win: they stay with the SEC; only exchanges without a stored regulator move.
